verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API development and testing client (REST/GraphQL requests, collections, CLI, MCP server for managing collections). Proxying and governing production LLM/MCP traffic with token limits, prompt guards and provider routing belongs to an AI/API gateway, a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows Hoppscotch shipping gateway-style traffic governance; its AI features cover request renaming, payload generation and script writing.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can proxy and govern LLM/MCP traffic (token limits, prompt guards, provider routing) through the platform
